Description
Elevate your lifestyle with this exceptional townhome situated in an exclusive, upscale neighbourhood. Immerse yourself in the serene beauty of an expansive rooftop deck, perfect for entertaining or simply savouring the picturesque vistas where breathtaking water, city, and mountain views await. Step into the private master suite offers a retreat-like ambiance with its spacious layout, walk-in closet, and lavish bathroom featuring a soaker tub and separate shower. Maple hardwood floors and stylish glass railings enhance the home's elegance, while the gourmet kitchen, equipped with high-end appliances, ensures a seamless culinary experience.

Description
Welcome to this exceptional Net-Zero front half-duplex in Point Grey, designed by Marrimor Interiors & built by True Maple Construction. Defined by high-performance sustainability & bespoke craft, the sun-lit main floor features a chef’s kitchen with integrated Miele appliances, custom millwork, & an oversized island. Upstairs, 3 bedrooms each enjoy a private ensuite with radiant in-floor heating, highlighted by a serene primary suite with a spa-inspired bath & WIC. The top level opens to a private balcony framing North Shore mountain & skyline views. Complete with 4 baths, central A/C, crawl space storage, & an EV garage. Steps from W 10th shops, cafes, top schools, UBC, Jericho Beach & Spanish Banks. If viewing on Zillow please text or email the leasing agent.

Exquisite UNFURNISHED 4 bdrm, 3 bath waterfront house on prestigious Point Grey Road offering 3,825 sq ft of spacious living w/ spectacular ocean & mountain views. Upper floor features master suite w/ ensuite, walk-in closet & private deck overlooking water, plus 2 bright additional bedrooms w/ shared bath. Main level showcases dramatic sunken living rm w/ fireplace & large windows framing waterfront views, open-concept kitchen w/ s/s appls & granite counters, family rm & dining area. Garden level offers self-contained suite w/ kitchenette, ideal for in-law, caregiver or visiting family. Extensive outdoor spaces incl. patio & deck w/ direct water access, beautifully landscaped private yard. Pets upon approval.

This stunning Kitsilano gem is an absolute must see! 2 bedrooms, 1.5 bathroom UPPER level features a perfect layout for your family. Main floor contains a spacious living/dining area with cozy gas fireplace, natural hard wood flooring, large windows for plenty of natural light, clean neutral wall tones. A renovated open kitchen with plenty of storage within the white shaker cabinetry, wrap around countertops, stainless steel appliances, and windows. Well appointed primary with 2 piece ensuite bathroom and walk in closet. Insuite laundry and 4 piece bathroom with separate shower & jet tub. Private patio off the kitchen as well as includes a private single car garage. Also features one of the largest gardens in the area!
